output.headline: UPMC buys only in the target's own sub-sector, closed all three of its deals, and has the scale to support upper-quartile pricing.
output.differentiator: All three of its deals sit in the target's own sub-sector, the strongest factor in its ranking. Peer lines are not shown here, so no lead over other buyers is claimed.
output.why_them: Same-sub-sector buyer with a clean closing record and large balance sheet

acquirer_overview.title: A large strategic with a short but fully closed record
points: Strategic buyer with Revenue US$27.7 billion (2023) and hospitals in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York [P:1, P:2].
Three deals between 2018 and 2020: all three closed and all were control deals, none minority stakes [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024, extending its footprint [P:2].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Own-sub-sector record and margin fit make the target a natural add-on
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; target margin close to what it usually buys is a strong factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
All three deals are in Healthcare Services, none in adjacent provider sub-sectors [K:by_sub_sector, T:record].

Platform Build appears in 1 of 3 deals, against 23% of all deals in the file, a modest add-on motive [M:platform_build]. Geographic Expansion (2 of 3) is common across the file, so it is not distinctive [M:geographic_expansion].

precedent_activity.title: Three same-sub-sector precedents, none in the size band or recent
points: Sterling Care Network: $55M Strategic Acquisition, 2020, at 11.3x EBITDA [D:MA-2020-0312].
Principal Behavioral Health: $444M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2019, at 11.7x. Keystone Behavioral Health: $33M Recapitalization, 2018, at 17.0x [D:MA-2019-0090, D:MA-2018-0486].
None of the three falls in the $100M-$400M comparable size band, and none were since 2022 [K:size_band, K:recent].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible and within UPMC's capacity
points: Across 70 comparable deals, EV/EBITDA runs from 10.7x (25th) through a 12.8x median to 15.3x (75th) [V:comps].
Target margin of 16.8% is above the comparable median of 12.9% and above 87% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile [V:comps].
UPMC's median paid is 11.7x, below that level. Cost synergies give headroom of $15M-$25M, against Revenue US$27.7 billion (2023) [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Dormant acquirer
risk_flags.concern: Last deal was in 2020 and none since 2022; recency is a slight factor against [K:recent, S:recency].
risk_flags.mitigant: Washington Health System merged with UPMC in 2024, showing continued appetite for combinations [P:2].
risk_flags.reality: Recent activity was a merger, not a comparable acquisition, so appetite needs testing [P:2, T:record].

risk_flags.title: Price gap to the 75th percentile
risk_flags.concern: UPMC's median paid of 11.7x sits below the 15.3x 75th percentile the target warrants [V:comps].
risk_flags.mitigant: It paid 17.0x for Keystone Behavioral Health in 2018, and cost synergy headroom is $15M-$25M [D:MA-2018-0486, V:synergy].
risk_flags.reality: The 17.0x was a small $33M deal; stretching to the 75th is unproven at scale [D:MA-2018-0486].

risk_flags.title: No Midwest presence
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region; footprint is Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York [T:record, P:2].
risk_flags.mitigant: Past deals spanned Mountain West, Northeast and National regions [K:by_region].
risk_flags.reality: Regional reach is neutral in the ranking, not a negative factor [C:conviction].

conviction.rationale: Three deals in the target's own sub-sector, none in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and third on the priority list after review. No deal in the target's region is neutral [C:conviction, R:rank].
